newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Quickturn Design up.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Quickturn Design up.

text.p: Quickturn Design Systems Inc and Cyrix Corp were trading slightly higher than their closing price on the NASDAQ National Market in the after-hours session, traders said Thursday.
Both companies released their quarterly earnings earlier in the day.
Quickturn was trading at 19-7/16 against a close of 19-1/2, while Cyrix was trading at 21-5/8 against 21-3/8.
Meanwhile, Xirom Inc, which also released earnings, was trading at 24-1/8 compared with 24-1/4.
Although the stock exchange lifted its halt on trading on General Motors Corp, Raytheon Co and Northrop Grumman Corp, the stocks were not passing hands in the after-hours session, one trader said.
General Motors announced earlier in the day it will sell its Hughes Aircraft defense subsidiary to Raytheon in a deal worth $9.5 billion.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 19,900 shares compared to 6,000 on Wednesday.
Session two had a bigger 4,939,602-share volume against the previous day's 3,084,700.
